components.text:
By default, the Ritual of Magnetism searches down to bedrock in a radius of 3 blocks out from the Master Ritual Stone for ores to collect, pulling them to the surface. Tier 0, costs $(blood)5,000 LP$() to activate.
Use a Ritual Diviner for easier construction.

The search radius can be augmented by placing an expensive block directly underneath the Master Ritual Stone - progressively more valuable blocks (such as a Block of Iron, and beyond it a Block of Diamond) extend the radius further. Check the ritual's tooltip in-game (via the Ritual Diviner or a Divination Sigil) for the exact current radius values on this branch.
